subject: Geopolitics
title: The Iran Nuclear Deal
description: A fast breakdown of The Iran Nuclear Deal for builders.

hook.text: In 2015 the world struck a deal to limit Iran's nuclear program. In 2018 the US tore it up.

buildup.text: The JCPOA froze Iran's enrichment in exchange for sanctions relief. Inspectors verified compliance rigorously.

discovery.text: The deal was a compromise: Iran kept civilian nuclear tech but couldn't build a bomb for at least 15 years.

twist.text: Trump withdrew, calling it the worst deal ever. Iran resumed enrichment and is now closer to a bomb than before.

climax.text: The JCPOA shows how fragile diplomatic deals are. One election in one country can undo years of negotiation.

punchline.text: A treaty is only as stable as the politics behind it.

quiz.question: What happened after the US withdrew from the Iran nuclear deal?
options: Iran immediately built a nuclear weapon
Iran resumed enrichment and moved closer to bomb capability
A new, stronger deal was quickly negotiated
